authorization.scope: Publish the 5 evidence.tar.gz grading archives under bench/regrading/rule-v3-regrade-2026-10-23-rebuilt-rulings-2/ to a public release of kamui/code-review-bench in the categories Grading and Integrity, packaged without recompressing or editing their bytes, after credential and identity reviews.

selection.path_rule: Each archive's portable path is its repository path, the path its committed evidence.json pins. Every archive's SHA-256 equalled its evidence.json hash before packing, and every package member keeps that hash.

credential_review.reviewed: 2026-10-24, before the release was created; the package members, extracted into an empty folder, were compared byte for byte with the scanned archives
credential_review.method: Every member of every archive read in memory and searched byte for byte; every member is a regular file and none is a gzip stream. The same scan of the 60 archives of evidence-rule-v3-regrade-2026-10-23-rulings-v1 reproduced that publication's counts.

pattern_definitions.credential-file-name: member basename auth.json, .credentials.json, credentials, credentials.json, .netrc, .npmrc, .pypirc, id_rsa, id_ed25519, .env, hosts.yml, .git-credentials or config.toml

false_positives.where: work/packet.md and the grader transcript of each of the 4 r-base-ui-5460 archives
false_positives.reason: The Netlify deploy-preview QR-code link in a public comment on mui/base-ui pull request 5460. Its HS256 payload holds only {"url":"https://deploy-preview-5460--base-ui.netlify.app"}, as in evidence-publication.v1.json and v2.

identity_review.account_email: The owner's email address, 15 times in all 5 grader transcripts: twice in the userEmail session_context attachment and once in the recorded request of each. The same kind of value is already public in evidence-rule-v3-regrade-2026-10-23-v1, evidence-rule-v3-regrade-2026-10-23-rulings-v1 and evidence-repository-payloads-2026-10-08-v1.
identity_review.organization_id: One organization UUID, in the credential_org attachment of each of the 5 grader transcripts; that attachment holds only the UUID, the same value as in the 60 archives of evidence-rule-v3-regrade-2026-10-23-rulings-v1.
identity_review.other_addresses: 2 occurrences of one maintainer address in a Dockerfile label of the reviewed project, in the q-soba-195 grader transcript; the same address is in the archives of evidence-rule-v3-regrade-2026-10-23-rulings-v1.
identity_review.home_paths: 640 mentions of the local home directory in 45 files.
identity_review.other_account_ids: No creator, account, user or installation ID and no plan type is in any member.
identity_review.ambient_context: No personal instructions file, memory index or installed-skills list is in any transcript; the transcripts carry the same attachment kinds as the 60 archives of evidence-rule-v3-regrade-2026-10-23-rulings-v1. Each transcript records its session's environment (working folder, platform, shell and OS version), model and date.

exclusions: Authentication files, client configuration and unrelated account state: no archive member is a credential file, and the archives hold only the grading workspace that bench-tools regrade archive-attempt recorded.
The committed evidence.json records, which stay in Git and pin each archive's hash.
The grading workspaces' clones and runtime store, and this publication's scratch folder.
limitations: The local source files stay on this machine: the 5 archives are ignored by Git at their repository paths.

publication.cold_fetch: bench-tools evidence fetch of the whole manifest into an empty root restored all 5 archives; each matched its source byte for byte and its evidence.json SHA-256.
commands: gh release create evidence-rule-v3-regrade-2026-10-23-rulings-2-v1 --repo kamui/code-review-bench --title 'Rule v3 regrade second-pass grading archives v1' --notes 'Immutable benchmark evidence payloads.'
